mapper.insert: insert into oa_member_log (member_id, action, dept_id, before_json, after_json, operator_id, operator_name, ip, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{action}, #{deptId}, #{beforeJson}, #{afterJson}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{ip}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select l.log_id, l.member_id, l.action, l.dept_id, l.before_json, l.after_json, l.operator_id, l.operator_name, l.ip, l.create_time from oa_member_log l where l.log_id = #{logId}

select l.log_id, l.member_id, l.action, l.dept_id, d.dept_name, l.before_json, l.after_json, l.operator_id, l.operator_name, l.ip, l.create_time from oa_member_log l left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = l.dept_id where l.member_id = #{memberId} order by l.log_id desc limit #{limit}
